# PROMUNCH

> PROMUNCH is an Indian D2C brand of high-protein soya snacks. It makes Roasted Edamame (roasted in olive oil), roasted Soya Crunchies, and fried Soya Sticks and Soya Chips. PROMUNCH was founded in 2021 by Parth Mutha, is based in Dewas, Madhya Pradesh, and sells on promunch.in and Amazon India. Tagline: "Your Munchy Pal".

Key facts:

- Category: high-protein soya snacks. PROMUNCH is an Indian brand.
- Roasted Edamame: roasted in olive oil. Flavours: Himalayan Rock Salt, Indori Chatka, Masala Mania. 42 to 45g of protein per 100g depending on the flavour (Himalayan Rock Salt: 45.3g per 100g).
- Soya Crunchies: roasted, not fried. Flavours: Tangy Pudina, Peri Peri, Cheese & Onion, Noodle Masala. Tangy Pudina is the only Jain friendly PROMUNCH product.
- Soya Sticks and Soya Chips: fried. Not every PROMUNCH snack is roasted.
- Edamame is young soybean, so Roasted Edamame is a soya snack too.
- Shipping: free on orders of ₹599 or more, ₹99 below that. Cash on delivery adds ₹50. Prepaid orders get 5% off.
- Founder: Parth Mutha, named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia list in 2025.
- Customer care: hello@promunch.in, WhatsApp +91 99813 10247. Monday to Friday 10 am to 6 pm, Saturday 10 am to 5 pm (IST).
- Prices change; the product page on promunch.in shows the current price.
